critique.evidence: The oversized “Detection changes the business model” thesis and red-to-cyan before/after attacker ledger create a clear narrative, while the repeated 25.60× ROI badge gives the screen a recognizable focal point across desktop, tablet, and mobile. However, the core visual language remains a conventional comparison table plus circular KPI gauge, so the concept is more memorable than the actual visualization and falls short of a signature hackathon-demo moment.
critique.fix: Replace the generic ledger-and-gauge centerpiece with a distinctive visual showing attacker economics collapsing from 545.35× to 25.60×—for example, an animated ROI curve or attack-attempt funnel tied directly to the before/after figures—while retaining the strong editorial headline and color semantics.
